batting.name: JD Ryder
batting.dismissal: c DB Ravi Teja b DW Steyn

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c PP Ojha b DT Christian

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b DT Christian

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: st RV Uthappa b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b R Sharma

balls.text: pulled through mid-wicket from Parnell, times it well and Christian makes good ground to cut it off and haul it back in. The batsmen want three but the throw comes in strong at the bowler's end and Parnell struggles to make his ground. Ojha runs him out
doesn't miss this one, comes down to the track and makes the right kind of contact, over long off for six
round the wicket and bowls a fullish ball, Parnell is trying to play some sort of pull and misses completely
pushed to long off, just takes one and gets Parnell on strike
Ojha has the last laugh. Marsh tries to play a similar shot, plays too early and doesn't read the turn very well. The ball sneaks through and middle stump is removed
Sanga has decided that Ojha will bowl the last over and what a start this is. Whack! Marsh smacks that into the sight screen, again just a step forward and its gone high and long and all the way
turned to short fine, good over for Pune from these two, the last one is coming up
driven through the off side, down to sweeper cover
dropped  pulled very hard from Marsh, down to Christian at long on who gets to and then lets it go, perhaps the momentum from running just saw the ball pop out
full toss and Marsh takes one step towards it and smacks over point, great shot
played off the pads through midwicket, leg bye called
back of a length and driven off the back foot to long on
looks to drive that through mid on but Mishra does some decent fieldin off his bowling and its just one

that is huge. Mishra gave it air, good length, invites Marsh to come down the wicket and he does and lifts it over long off. It went very high and wasn't very well timed but he still got maximum results
there's the legbreak, flicked off the hips for one
looks to flick away quite aggresively to fine leg but only gets to short fine, thats the third googly from Mishra in this over
defended back to Mishra
turmed to third man, Sharma over-runs that, small misfield
pushed into the off side in defence. Good over from Ojha, just the three from it.
Marsh moves the ball again and pushed to long on, they want two and they have to hurry but they get it
slapped to point
tapped into the off side, they call for the run quickly and scrambl through
pushed away to shortg fine leg, just singles now
Ojha is back now, turned to the leg side
swept away for one
bit too much on that, down the leg side and its wide
googly now from Mishra, Marsh carves it through to the off side
turned around to square leg
defended backtno Mishra, who misfields off hsi own bowling and allows for a run
Parnell's got the dancing shows on and moves to the ball before slapping it into the off side
Mishra flights it and it's pushed to the off side for one
back of a length and Parnell nudges it to point, he has a big role to play today

maybe he needed a new bat. Christian banged it in short, Yuvi went on a wild pull and got a thick nick through to Sanga who celebrated with great glee. Dangerous Yuvi is gone but we know Pune bat deep
pushed into the covers, something else bothering Yuvi now, he wants a new bat
driven to mid off this time
short and picked up very well by Mitchell Marsh. He hoicked that over mid-wicket, high and mighty. Classic bludgeon, if such a thing exists
driven off the back foot to mid-off, hit too quickly and there's no run there
lovely shot for one. Smacked down to deep extra, Marsh stands nice and tall and gets hold of it, only one though
poked down to extra cover
that's the first extra of the match. Steyn goes down the leg side, appeals for caught behind but that's nonsense it's wide
squirted down to fine leg, Marsh actually looking to play on the off side and gets it wrong
very good from Steyn, goes past the outside edge and over the top of the stumps, Marsh can't play that
full again and pushed into the gap between point and cover
full and Yuvi drives, but he only gets it to point
defended back to Christian, good comeback from him
still bowling it back of a length and its working, Driven uppishly into the covers, limp shots here and no scoring opportunities really
touch shorter and defended again, decent from Christian
defended back to Christian
defended on the back foot, back to Christian. Prudhvi makes this observation, "No extras yet.. very commendable.."
nicely timed through mid-wicket, flicked in that region for a couple
turned to short fine leg, Mishra swoops and there's no run
nice shot, Yuvi looking very good. Pulled through mid-wicket, that right in his slot and if Duminy bowls there, that will happen
turns past the outside edge, Yuvraj almost got a nick to third man and was lucky not to
carved through the off side, quick single taken
pushed back to Duminy, collects on the follow through in the same fashion as the previous ball, this one bounced before though

soft, soft, soft! My word. Ferguson just handed that back to Duminy, easiest caught and bowled in the world. It was pushed back at catchable height and Duminy took it in the follow through, bouncing to his right
back to back boundaries, no turn on that and Yuvi drives to long off, straight as a pin and stunning
lovely from Yuvraj, gets himself into a good position to loft that over mid-wicket, Ojhan dropped it too short and Yuvi pounced
defended softly, back to the bowler
pushed off the back foot onto the off side
arm ball, Ferguson pulls to mid-wicket
beaten. Ojha bowls it well, flighted and turns past the outside edge, Gerguson beaten
super shot from Yuvi, shorter from Mishra and Yuvi gets on the back foot and pulls quite flat and low through mid-wicket. Steyn is the fielder on the rope and he falls flat trying to collect
gives it air again and it's driven to mid-off, they want the run no matter what and scrambl through, there's a direct hit at the bowler's end but it doesn't matter, he's safe
not too loopy this time and driven off the back foot to long on
flighted delivery, still on the legstump line and angled to fine leg
keeps it straight and on legstump, turned around the corner for one
Mishra is back, that's the first run scored off him, lobbed to mid-off
back of a length and pushed through the off side, only one available there and we'll time out now
short ball, Ferguson on the pull but can't make contact. That was really fired in from Sharma
not beaten this time. Ferguson upper cuts but not forcefully enough, travells along the ground and Ojha cuts it off
finally some runs. Little bit of width and Ferguson drives behind square on the off side. Pragyna Ojha comes round from third man, but the timing is too good and he is beaten
good length and Ferguson wants to cut but has a small swing and misses
clipped away through square leg
and he doesn't get it. Decent enough delivery, played on the off side
the googly gets Manhas. It turns back into him and he gets an inside edge as he tries to cut away. Mishra on a hattrick
Mishra takes the catch off his own bowling.  Loopy delivery and Uthappa gets a leading edge back to Mishra It's low down but he has no problem taking it.
gives it a bit of air and pushed onto the on side
goes back and pushes back to Mishra
Amit Mishra is on now, starts off with one that Yuvraj wants to whip away on the leg side, but gets hit on the pads
ends in quiet fashion, defended again.
defended back to Ojha
Ojha ends Pandey's up and down stint at the wicket. He makes some room and wants to cut away but he misses and middle stump is uprooted.
what a ripper! Goes past the outside edge and Pandey has no clue.
That's big! Pandey doesn't allow it to be quiet for too long. He just launched into that one and smacked over long on.
here's Ojha, starts quiely, defended back to the bowler
bit too much width outside off, that didn't require too mcuh work to steer into the gap to the third man boundary. Successful over for Christian none the less
and would you look at that. Shorter ball, Ganguly plays a limp shot, in the air, half-hearted drive and it's straight to Ojha in the covers. Simple as you like and taken comfortably.
good start for Christian, length ball again and defended into the off side, four dots now
length ball, tapped down into the off side, thoughts of a run, but they don't want it
gets this one to go away from Dada, who makes some room and tries to cut, but he has made too much room and cant get to it
Dan Christian is on, starts off with a length ball, pushed into the covers
Pandey finally gets his short ball, he wants to pull, of course, but doesn't make contact and it carrie through to the keeper
driven to mid on
good bowling from Sharma, gets it to move in and Pandey is watchful
lucky, lucky, Pandey. He has a wild swing at a length ball outside off and that goes over the top of first slip and to the third man boundary for four
length ball outside off and just nips away. Pandey is still waiting for the short ball and that beats him totally
good length and inside edged onto the pads

just back of a length, Ryder is on the back foot and drives with great force. That was destined for the cover boundary but met with Rav Teja instead. It was hit low and dying on him but he got down and to his left fast enough to pouch it
short again from Steyn and Pandey pulls, mistimed again, he is looking uncomfortable with this shot. It goes high and to fine leg, Sharam makes good gorund but can't get to it
driven this time, to mid-on, that area is being marshalled and there's just one

Steyn still looking to swing it in, goes short again, and Ryder walks across his stumps to try to flick on the legside, he misses and Sanga collects outside the ine of leg, not called wide, and rightly so
full toss on legstump and that's too inviting for Ryder not to gobble up. He clips it away from the pads and it races through to fine leg for four
Steyn bangs one in short and Ryder looks to cut away, possibly upper cut, but he swings and misses
full delivery, pushed to mid on, Pandey wants one but Ryder says no
length ball, Pandey seems to have no idea what's going on and backs away only to see the ball carry over the stumps

oooohhh, that's lucky. Short ball, quicker as well, and Pandey pulls with his eyes closed, just about and it could have gone anywhere, It went to fine leg, and Steyn had to chase, but it was in the air a while
back of a length now and Pandey defends it back to Ishant
fullish delivery, great use of the wrists from Pandey, who also lifts his back leg in execution, and it trickles away for four
Ishant Sharma takes over Duminy and starts off with a length ball. Ryder has a huge heave and only manages to swing to fine leg
pushed to deep mid-wicket, Ryder swings around quickly to position it into the open space there. Pandey wants three and good running gets them that, comfortably, in fact
slightly shorter and pushed to point, Ryder looking a little too measured
a little bit of width outside off, Ryder goes back and looks to punch through the covers but again, doesn't get hold of it well enough
back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Ryder looks to whip away on the leg side, but doesn't really get hold of it
Pandey goes back and nudges this down onto his feet, sets off for the run quickly and gets it
Steyn shares the new ball, two South Africans now and he's getting some away movement, Pandey leaves alone
tossed up and invites the drive, Ryder pushes it past short third man, in the air a little but safe
this is costly. Ryder comes down the track and mis-hits it over long off. That was with the toe-end of the bat but it still went miles
straighter this time and Pandey is on the pull, not timed very well and he only gets one
and it is well. That's slightly short and Pandey can make room to cut through point. Teja makes an attempt to save it but can't
first runs, Ryder is on the back foot and pushed that through the covers, now to see how Pandey handles the spin, and it should be well
and there's an appeal immediately. Raps Ryder on the pad and it's very optimistic. Looks to be going over leg and middle. Ryder also got an inside edge on that
cracked through the covers, full from Parnell, and there's ample room and time to get the boundary
starts with a short one, pulled down to fine leg, collected on the bounce
trying another big shot, the big pull but gets a bottomish edge to short fine, Deccan determined to go out with a big bang
gives this one an almighty thwack, whips it through midwicket
Christian mistimes, slogs across the line and gets a leading edge over where slip would be, runs away for a couple
pushed to mid-wicket, no one there to stop the runs, easy
driven to long on
Yuvi keeps it straight and Christian knocks it back to him
bouncer to end the over, Chipli doesn't even try wrestle with that one

wicket to wicket again, Chipli pushes into the off side and wants one, Parnell is swooping again and just as he is about to collect, Yuvi comes charging in, Parnell goes down and covers his head for fear of being attacked, Yuvi lifts him up and laughs

Parny cleans up his SA teammate. What a super ball. He's been fast and furious in this over and keeps this one straight. Duminy is not watching as he should be and ge plays too late, legstump is pinged back and there's some joy for an otherwise listless Pune
quick again and Duminy  looks to cut but that's too quick on him and he misses
fires it in full, drives to mid off and Marsh moves quickly to cut it off
Parnell is back and its steered down to third man
defends into the leg side, 12 off this over, and 13 left to get
along the ground to long on this time
Duminy gets going, What a biggie! Comes down the track a littl and hits over long on, very big and victory is close now
driven to covers for a quick single
tries to hit it through square leg but can't beat the fielder there
Yuvi brings himself back and Christian is on the drive, times it well to mid on and its four
turning to the leg side again, no run this time, still a cake wake for Deccan
looking to play down the leg side and misses, its called wide in fact
now he does, turns it through midwicket where Yuvi cant get to it in time and allows two
Duminy cant get it away, pushes into the off side, awkward
turns it around the corner to short fine
Dan Christian starts tentatively, pushes it into the off side, gets one

Sanga walks and ends his last innings at this IPL. It's the ball that came straight on, Sanga was looking to cut or steer down to third man and got a sizeable edge. Uthappa was up immediately and Sanga didn't wait to see what the umpire thought of that, he was off in a flash.
goes aerial, down to long on and there's another one there
slaps it through the point area, it reaches the boundary rope where the third man fielder is, just one
defended back to Manhas, Duminy not trying anything silly
turned to the leg side
that is too good from Sanga, gets to the ball and lofts it with a straight bat down the ground fo six. The timing and class on that shot is exemplary. Too good.
Duminy drives uppishly and threads it through the covers, Marsh on the cover boundary does well and keeps it down to three
this time its picked up well, still fullish from Marsh and Sanga gets under it and picks it from outside off to deposit it over midwicket, one bounce and thats four
Marsh keeps it full and its driven back to him, good shot but he is equally good at fielding off his own bowling
yorker length, Sanga keeps it out
on leg stump line, Duminy gives it a gentle push to the leg side
full againn, Sanga gets under it and goes aerial, to long off, didnt get enough on it, just one
Mitchell Marsh is back, and starts with a full one, driven to mid off on the up
defended back to the bowler
clipped to square leg, Duminy wants the run and its going to be tight, Yuvi shies at the stumps, needs a direct hit though
again, on the leg side, so much space there, and its easy to amble through for the one
whips it through square leg, quite a rash shot and he doesn't need to do that, gets away with it though
pushed onto the leg side and there's a lot of room there to get the one
pushed down to long on, Manhas continuing
pushed to square leg, Rahul Sharma bowls another good over
driven down to mid on
Duminy battling here, looking to steer down to third man and it just turns away from him and he is beaten
pushed past the bowler, who makes a decent attempt to stop the single but lets it go through for one
hits to the fielder this time, quiet softly and there's time for the run
pushed into the gap in the covers, Sanga just knocking it around a bit
Duminy has a slash at that one but is beaten by a quicker one
now Sanga gets something, counters the turn and works it through midwicket
tries to get it through the covers put cant
Manhas keeps it tight, forces the defensive stroke again
pushed in the air into the covers, loud cries of words I can't type here, Uthappa thought that was a chance
defended down the track
steered down to third man, Rolls away until it makes contact with the boundary rope, turns out to be well timed
that's tango, JP moves to the ball and drives to long off, runs well
this time he is cramped on the back foot, defends again
moves to the ball, comes down the wicket and defends
could there be a twist here? Rahul Sharma gets Sohal lbw. Not much turn on that, and strikes Sohal on the back pad, not much to do but call that out.
cut away through point, runs away to the boundary rope but its cut off there
waits for it nicely and plays out to third man, four from the over and it's time to time-out
flighted again and pushed out to mid off
worked through midwicket, Sanga so good at these shots
defended back to Yuvi, cries of "lovely Yuvi" from Uthappa
Sanga turns it nice and fine past between the keeper and short leg and gets two
Yuvi does it for Pune. Flights this one, its the arm ball and Dhawan has come down quite far to hit that. He is well outside his crease and it's an easy stumping for Uthappa
full again, gentle drive to long off, Deccan are well and truly on track
and that spoils it, full again, Dhawan gets under it and lofts down the ground, couple of bounces and its four
low full toss and Dhawan drives into the cover, better from Marsh this over
fuller now and it's dabbed out to mid off
now he drops it short and Sohal is on the pull, but misses, he still wants to back away to every ball
Sohal still throwing his bat at everything. Marsh bowls it full and he can't get to it at all
turned to square leg
beats the bat on that occasion, Sohal has taken a big step but his back foot is grounded, Uthappa thinks he may have him stumped, he hasn't
pushed to mid-on
threads it to deep cover, hits very hard for that shot
flighted delivery, Sohal wants to play the reverse sweep, gets down on one knee and gets an edge almost, up a little bit but safe
Yuvi comes on now and that's turned past square leg
goes a little fuller and its pushed to mid off
oh it's too good! Short ball and Dhawan doesn't have to move his feet to upper cut to third man
smacked down the ground, no timining on that one and hit between mid off and mid on, just the one
slower ball from Marsh and its well picked yorker length, Sohal backs away again and adjusts to flick it through fine leg
short ball from Marsh, Sohal persists with backing away and misses the pull shot, called wide again, square leg umpire has called it for height
Sohal doesn't need him yet, again, he makes that room, moves the front leg away, swings hard and sends it sailing over long on
Sohal doesn't have a runner yet and he makes some room and slaps that to mid on
nice and wristy, turned to fine leg and there's less than 100 to get now
good shot, Sohal takes a big step and whacks it over extra cover, well timed and well placed
dabbed into the off side and its a comfortable one
defended off the back foot, into the point area, quick running again
good ball, turns away from Sohal, who looks to cut and plays too early, misses
drops it short and Dhawan moves to the pitch of the ball, pushed to mid off
clipped away through fine leg for four, expensive from Parnell

oh gosh! Parnell is having no luck. Saw Sohal backing away and followed him with the short ball, it goes over Sohal and Uthappa can't get to it in time. It's called wide for height and runs away for four, veru unlucky
short again and lofted down to third man, its in the air for some time and Kumar runs around and dives forward, tries to take the catch, but it would have been tough, good effort
short ball from Parnell, too high for Dhawan to get up to
cut way to point, well fielded
yorker, doesn't get it exactly right and its well dug out
turned down to fine leg, takes the bottom hand off the handle as he hits that
hits the pads on its way down the eg side, slower from Parnell and called wide
Dhawan moves to the pitch of the ball, there's intent to hoick it over long on but he is too quick on the shot and gets a small inside edge onto the pads
more on the line of middle, played out to mid-wicket and very good running gets them two
pitches outside leg and there's a stifled appeal as Dhawan is hit on the pads
dabbed into the off side and can't get it away too far
not too much wrong with that ball but Dhawan hits it so sweetly, timed well again through the gap on the off side and no fielder can win the battle with this one
looks to steer to third man, Jesser Ryder is surprisingly atheltic at short third and stops one
bouncer and Sohal thinks he can get on top of it and pull, he needs to reach pretty high though and can't get there
looks to pierce that gap again, but it's not hit with as much force and there's only a single on offer this time
fine shot, short and wide and punctures the gap in the off side. Dhawan gets a good stride in and times it well
pushed into the off side, light touch and sets off for the run as the ball is hit
moves away and cut into the covers
wayward from Parnell, can't control the swing and goes down the leg side, called wide
back of a length, nudged away to the off side, quick running again
this time he doesn't miss, cut neatly off the back foot, awkward bounce for the cover fielder, who misfields and lets through a couple
short and Sohal makes room to cut away, has a flash and misses
dabbed into the off side, they have to be quick again and they are to complete the run
Dhawan faces his first ball, cut away to point, Ferguson is there to collect
a little bit shorter and tucked away on the leg side, good running
back of a length and dabbed into the off side to point
